entries.value: Farmland is becoming worn-out and depleted — old Roman drainage has failed and bogs are returning
Verminous monsters are swarming from the fens, moors, or barrows
A rebel front is stirring up trouble against the High King or regional lord
A foreign power is backing internal strife — Saxon lords, Irish pirates, or a rival British king
The leadership is inept and distracted by private pleasures or petty quarrels
A religious reformer is breaking old compacts between church and secular power
An evil is provoking outraged rioting — a dark cult, a monstrous tribute, an unjust judgment
Dark cults are attracting the ambitious and the desperate
A Saxon or Pictish horde is threatening the borders
An ancient ruin has disgorged some peril — barrow-wights, a bound evil, a faerie court angered
Malcontents have obtained a potent relic and are using it against the kingdom
Luxuriance has left the king's coffers bare — a great feast, a failed campaign, a royal ransom
Local lords are pushing for independence or refusing to send levies
An important mine or resource site has run out or been seized by enemies
A sinister favourite has infatuated the lord — a foreign sorceress, a corrupt churchman, a flatterer
A recurring cattle plague or crop blight is causing hunger
Fearsome monsters are migrating into settled lands from the wilderness
A rival king is preparing for war or raiding
A grand national plan is exhausting the people — road-building, a fortress, a campaign
A savage grudge has erupted into open violence between two great lords
